title: 联邦机构将AI批评者视为“外国代理人”
summary: 本文报道了美国联邦机构将批评人工智能的人士视为“外国代理人”的现象。文章指出，随着AI技术的快速发展，对其潜在风险提出质疑的批评者可能被政府机构标记为外国势力代理人，引发对言论自由和学术自由的担忧。该报道在Hacker News上获得306点积分和316条评论，表明技术社区对此话题高度关注。文章探讨了政府监控与AI批评之间的紧张关系，以及这种标签化对技术讨论环境的潜在影响。
summary_en: This article reports that U.S. federal agencies are targeting critics of artificial intelligence as 'foreign agents.' It highlights concerns that individuals questioning the potential risks of AI may be labeled as agents of foreign powers, raising issues about free speech and academic freedom. The story garnered significant attention on Hacker News with 306 points and 316 comments, indicating strong interest from the tech community. The article examines the tension between government surveillance and AI criticism, and the potential impact of such labeling on the environment for technical discourse.
